storyCards.headline: Nothing Compares 2 U: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Sinead O'connor's "Nothing Compares 2 U" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

Nothing Compares 2 U was released in 1990.
